annotations.title: Resolve a gene symbol, alias or stable identifier

description: Find the authoritative public human gene identity for a symbol, previous symbol, alias, HGNC, Ensembl or NCBI Gene identifier. Returns exact, alias, ambiguous, not_found or withdrawn with all candidates and identity_snapshot_id. Never choose an ambiguous candidate or substitute a withdrawn identity. Use the selected HGNC gene_id and snapshot with get_gene_profile. Gene-plus-HGVS and variant expressions belong in search_variant_evidence. No patient or case narrative.

query.description: One public gene symbol, previous symbol, alias, HGNC ID, Ensembl gene ID or NCBI Gene ID. No patient or case narrative.
